test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is FALSE about the right to freedom of religion mentioned in the Indian Constitution?

options.text: It provides freedom to manage religious affairs.
It is mentioned in Articles 25 to 28.
It mentions that the state has its own religion.

solution:
The correct answer is__** It mentions that the state has its own religion.**__
